name: AQI PM2.5 24hr breakpoints gradient
source: EPA AQI category breakpoints, 24-hour PM2.5 (ug/m3) mapped to 8-hour ozone (ppb), so each PM2.5 category spans the same AQI O3 8hr breakpoints gradient colors as its ozone category
notes: Borrows the AQI O3 8hr breakpoints gradient stops, so it shares their limits: see that colormap's notes.
